ZWE.note: Nothing on AI rules or harms.
No AI system in use stated; AI is only mentioned as a strategy to align with.
No AI tool in a sector system stated.
Only says the President launched an AI Strategy in March 2026; a launch is not adoption and no approval is stated.

facts.fact: The Procurement Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe's eGP system, launched by the President in October 2023, became operational on 1 January 2024 for all public entities and bidders to conduct procurement electronically, and is to be enhanced and renamed ZEPPS from January 2027.
